name: Exp_iWPRSign
summary: This EA trades based on the iWPRSign custom indicator, which generates buy and sell signals from Williams' Percent Range (WPR) crossing overbought/oversold levels. It opens and closes positions systematically on new bar signals, with configurable money management modes and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于iWPRSign自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过威廉百分比（WPR）穿越超买/超卖水平生成买卖信号。它在新K线信号上系统性地开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理模式和固定止损/止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于威廉百分比范围（WPR）指标的超买超卖反转信号，当WPR穿越上轨（-30）时产生买入信号，穿越下轨（-70）时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：WPR上穿-30水平时做多，WPR下穿-70水平时做空，仅在指定信号K线上触发。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，以及反向信号平仓——买入信号同时可平卖仓，卖出信号同时可平买仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含亏损自由保证金比例、含亏损余额比例及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手或10%资金。EA还包含历史K线回溯检测逻辑，当同时允许开仓和平仓时，会从信号K线向前搜索最近的反向信号以确认平仓条件。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Williams' Percent Range (WPR) overbought/oversold reversal signals, generating buy signals when WPR crosses above the -30 upper level and sell signals when WPR crosses below the -70 lower level. Entry conditions are: buy when WPR breaks above -30, sell when WPR breaks below -70, triggered only on the specified signal bar. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as reverse-signal closing where a buy signal can close a sell position and a sell signal can close a buy position. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-inclusive free margin percentage, loss-inclusive balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 10% of capital. The EA also includes a historical bar lookback detection logic that searches forward from the signal bar for the nearest reverse signal to confirm closing conditions when both opening and closing are enabled simultaneously.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制每笔交易的风险比例或手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/含亏损自由保证金/含亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平卖仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平买仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典WPR超买超卖反转信号，易于理解和验证
提供多种资金管理模式选择，灵活适应不同风险偏好
支持独立控制开仓和平仓方向，可灵活组合做多做空策略
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正向期望值潜力
使用新K线检测机制避免同根K线重复交易
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic WPR overbought/oversold reversal signals, easy to understand and verify
Multiple money management modes available, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
Independent control of opening and closing directions, allowing flexible long/short strategy combinations
Stop-loss to take-profit ratio of 1:2, providing positive expectancy potential
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same bar
cons: ATR_Period被硬编码为全局变量而非input参数，无法在策略测试器中优化
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高位点差环境下可能产生不利成交
历史K线回溯搜索平仓逻辑效率低，在K线数量多时可能造成性能问题
未检查当前是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
WPR水平参数固定为-30/-70，缺乏自适应或动态水平调整机制
cons_en: ATR_Period is hardcoded as a global variable instead of an input parameter, preventing optimization in the strategy tester
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Historical bar lookback search for closing logic is inefficient, potentially causing performance issues with many bars
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
WPR level parameters are fixed at -30/-70, lacking adaptive or dynamic level adjustment mechanism
improvements: 将ATR_Period改为input参数以支持策略优化
添加点差过滤和持仓检查逻辑，避免不利成交和重复开仓
优化历史K线回溯搜索逻辑，限制搜索范围或缓存结果以提高性能
improvements_en: Change ATR_Period to an input parameter to support strategy optimization
Add spread filter and position check logic to avoid unfavorable fills and duplicate entries
Optimize historical bar lookback search logic by limiting search range or caching results to improve performance

risk_points: 未检查当前同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓和过度杠杆
止损1000点较大，在高波动市场中可能承受较大单笔亏损
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中滑点成本不可控
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially leading to duplicate entries and excessive leverage
Stop-loss of 1000 points is relatively large, potentially incurring significant single-trade losses in volatile markets
No spread filter, making slippage costs uncontrollable in low-liquidity markets
